# System map (GENERATED -- do not edit by hand)

Generated by `node bus/platform/build-system-map.js --write` from `bus/components.json`, script header comments and the real `require` graph.
A test fails if this file is stale. For decisions and history see `docs/DECISIONS.md`; for what is scheduled see `bus/deploy/schedules.json` (check with `node bus/platform/check-schedules.js`).
Code lives in `bus/<domain>/<file>.js` (see the tables). `bus/scripts/` holds only compatibility symlinks for things outside the repo that still name the old paths (units, cron, the running daemon, allow rules); the list is `compatSymlinks` in `bus/components.json`.

## Domains

| Domain | Meaning | Files | Live | Paused | Manual | Library | Legacy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| platform | shared infrastructure | 29 | 2 | 0 | 8 | 11 | 8 |
| ops | dashboard and status aggregators (may read every domain) | 5 | 1 | 0 | 1 | 3 | 0 |
| fleet | paper-trading fleet | 26 | 0 | 4 | 2 | 17 | 3 |
| city | real-money agent city (survive) | 23 | 0 | 1 | 4 | 17 | 1 |
| swarm | research swarm | 4 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 3 | 0 |
| revenue | product builder, Apify and bounty tooling | 10 | 0 | 0 | 6 | 4 | 0 |
| org | autonomous organization runtime (durable Director/AgentSpec decision loop + Plan-2 economic cells, all real-money-execution paths hard-denied in this phase) | 12 | 0 | 0 | 4 | 8 | 0 |

**Dependency rules** (enforced by `bus/tests/survive/architecture.test.js`): platform -> platform; ops -> platform, ops, fleet, city, swarm, revenue, org; fleet -> fleet, platform; city -> city, platform; swarm -> swarm, platform; revenue -> revenue, platform; org -> org, platform.

**Documented exceptions:** survive-executor.js -> alpaca-client.js (rehearsal mode uses the paper client by injection); survive-executor.js -> execute-portfolio-setup.js (reuses the fleet parseStopPrice() for protective stops (documented design; debt: extract to platform)).

**Statuses:** live = running now; paused = scheduled/entrypoint intentionally off; manual = run by hand; library = required by other code; legacy = no live path; candidate to archive (do not delete without checking).
